description_en: Creates a UDP IP address range for Public DNS
description_zh: 创建公共DNS Udp Ip地址段
kebab_example: aliyun alidns create-pdns-udp-ip-segment --ip example-string --name example-string --lang example-string --ip-token example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePdnsUdpIpSegment

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the Public DNS enterprise recursive gateway
parameters.help_zh: 公共 DNS 企业递归网关的 IP 地址
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The name of the IP address range
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: Specifies the language for the response
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回信息使用的语言
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The client IP validation token. The service uses this token to look up the cached client IP address. If a cache miss occurs, the client IP address in the request is used
parameters.help_zh: 客户端 IP 校验令牌。服务使用该令牌查找已缓存的客户端 IP；未命中时使用请求中的客户端 IP
parameters.name: ip_token

ValidMessage.description_en: The validation result code returned when the IP address range is created. This parameter is empty if the validation succeeds
ValidMessage.description_zh: 创建地址段时的验证结果码；验证通过时为空
